name: 提案属性ごとに表示方法と条件を指定する管理行
prompt:
Create one faithful Japanese-localized product UI screenshot of the single settings row shown in the supplied reference crop. This is one standalone row, not a full settings page.

Match the reference's very wide, shallow horizontal layout: a white row with a faint top and bottom divider. At the far left, place a small pale-gray rounded square containing a simple dark-gray group-of-people icon. To its right, show exactly the Japanese attribute label 「担当者の提案」 in dark charcoal, vertically centered.

At the far right, place one white pill-shaped dropdown with a thin light-gray outline. It contains a small outlined focus/view glyph, the Japanese action label 「表示」, and a downward chevron. Immediately to its right, place a separate round outlined filter/settings button containing three horizontal filter lines. Preserve the wide gap between the label and these controls.

Use the primary reference for the control order, icon placement, spacing, divider, neutral color, and shallow row height. Use the Japanese mock for the localized text and icon style. Keep everything vertically centered. Use Meiryo Regular 14/24 for the row label and action. No helper text, no expanded dropdown, no filter popover, no extra settings, no page header or surrounding cards.

Fit the single row across an ultra-wide 12.67:1 canvas matching the primary reference crop. Do not add whitespace above or below. Render crisp and clean with no English text.
reviewNotes: The localized label and both controls match the requested row, but the 2170x725 canvas is 2.99:1 versus the 773x61 source crop at 12.67:1 and 648x64 Japanese mock at 10.13:1. Large white bands above and below require correction; exact icon and typography fidelity are unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
